Zero keys · runs in this page

Studio

Toy instruments for tokens, similarity, attention, retrieval, sampling, cost, and evals. They use fixed numbers so you can see the mechanism. They do not call a model.

Toy tokenizer

Longest match against a tiny vocabulary, then one character at a time. A shipping model uses its own trained tokenizer. Count with that one before you budget a prompt.

Cosine similarity

Cosine is the dot product divided by the two lengths. These vectors are hand-set teaching numbers, not the output of an embedding model.

Vector A
Vector B

Attention heatmap

Causal attention: a position may look at itself and earlier tokens only. The compute mode runs QKᵀ / √d and softmax on fixed toy vectors, with Wq and Wk as identity. The sketch mode is a hand-drawn pattern, not a trained model.

Mini retrieval

Six sample notes live in the page. Keyword overlap always runs. Preset questions also have a hand-set vector so you can see hybrid ranking. The answer is a template that quotes the winning chunk, or refuses. No model is called.

Temperature and top-p

Eight fixed logits. Temperature divides them before softmax. Top-p keeps the smallest high-probability set that reaches p, then renormalizes. Neither knob checks facts. A temperature of 0.05 stands in for greedy decoding; many APIs treat 0 as argmax.

Context budget and a cost sketch

Instructions, retrieved text, conversation, and reserved answer tokens share one window. Prices start empty. The example button fills placeholders, not a quote. Read your provider's card.

Loss sketch

A sketch of a shape you will see in training write-ups. Training loss falls. Validation loss can rise when the run memorizes. This is not a log from a named model.

Latency and quality, as a design sketch

Positions are for a design conversation. They are not a benchmark and they are not a ranking of vendors. A local model is not automatically more accurate. A long window is not automatically more careful.

Eval scorecard

Move the candidate against a baseline you set. The gate ships only when quality is not worse, safety failures are not higher, and latency and cost stay inside the budgets.

Embedding space, drawn in 2D

A picture of a toy space. Real embedding vectors have hundreds or thousands of dimensions. Click a point to mark its nearest neighbors by ordinary distance in this drawing.

Charts and calculators

Charts counted from this course are labeled that way. Every other number is a sketch. None of them call a model.

Lessons in each track

Counted from the lessons in this file. Not a quality score.

Reading minutes in each track

Counted from the lessons in this file. Not a quality score.

Lessons by level

Counted from the lessons in this file. Not a quality score.

Cumulative lessons along the tracks

Counted from the lessons in this file. Not a quality score.

How many lessons share a length

Counted from the lessons in this file. Not a quality score.

Track order

Counted from the lessons in this file. Not a quality score.

Lessons in the reference sections

Counted from the lessons in this file. Not a quality score.

Minutes by level

Counted from the lessons in this file. Not a quality score.

Example 7B weight file at a few bit widths

Weights only. A 7B Q4 file is about 3.5 GB. The 16 GB figure is a machine starting point, because the runner and KV cache are extra. Sketch. Not a benchmark and not a price.

Example Q4 weight file by parameter count

Formula: billions times bits/8. Sketch. Not a benchmark and not a price.

Example LoRA trainable count versus rank

2 × rank × (4096 + 4096) × 32 layers. Example dimensions, not a model card. Sketch. Not a benchmark and not a price.

Example adapter versus one full matrix stack

Full count is 4096 × 4096 × 32. Sketch. Not a benchmark and not a price.

Example context split

One shared window. These token counts are an example, not a bill. Sketch. Not a benchmark and not a price.

Toy mass on the top logit versus temperature

Fixed logits 4.2, 3.1, 1.6, 0.7. Temperature does not add facts. Sketch. Not a benchmark and not a price.

Toy probability kept by top-k

Same logits at temperature 1, before top-p. Sketch. Not a benchmark and not a price.

Hand-set retrieval score versus rerank score

A reranker cannot score a passage the first stage never fetched. Sketch. Not a benchmark and not a price.

Example token lines on one call

Counts, not prices. Fill prices from your own card. Sketch. Not a benchmark and not a price.

Example eval funnel

Ten tasks, all scored, two regressions, nothing shipped. Not yet is a finished result. Sketch. Not a benchmark and not a price.

Toy causal attention row

Hand-drawn pattern, the same kind the attention widget labels as a sketch. Not a model that knows geography.

Sketch of train and validation loss

Validation turning up is the memorization picture. Not a training run. Sketch. Not a benchmark and not a price.

Studio scorecard starting values

Different units, so the tall bar is latency in milliseconds, not a better score. Quality 84 is higher-better. Safety failures, latency, and cost are lower-better. This is the studio card that starts at gate fix. Sketch. Not a benchmark and not a price.

Example tool list

Allow, ask, and deny are a policy. This bar is an example list, not a recommendation of products. Sketch. Not a benchmark and not a price.

Character windows on one short note

A real splitter should keep the heading with the chunk. This count is ceil(length / window). Sketch. Not a benchmark and not a price.

Blend of a hand-set keyword score and a hand-set cosine

0.2 keyword and 0.9 cosine. The slider weight is the cosine share. Sketch. Not a benchmark and not a price.

Calls if every try is repeated

A retry can double the bill. Budget them. Counts, not prices. Sketch. Not a benchmark and not a price.

Sketch KV cache versus tokens

2 × 32 layers × 8 heads × 128 × tokens × 2 bytes. Not a runner report. Sketch. Not a benchmark and not a price.

Example adapter as a share of the full matrix stack

QLoRA keeps a quantized base frozen and trains the adapter. The bar is the rank-16 example as a percent of 4096 × 4096 × 32. It is not a memory chart. Sketch. Not a benchmark and not a price.

Steps left under an example cap of 6

Sketch. Not a benchmark and not a price.

Example citation coverage

One required id, one cited id. Empty is not a pass. Sketch. Not a benchmark and not a price.

Machine starting point versus an example weight file

8 GB starts smaller. 16 GB is the starting point for a 7B or 8B Q4 or Q5, not the size of the weight file. Sketch. Not a benchmark and not a price.

One agent loop

Propose, validate, observe, stop. A loop without a stop is not a design. Sketch. Not a benchmark and not a price.

When a second loop is justified

Most jobs stay one loop. A second loop starts from a file, not a shared chat. Sketch. Not a benchmark and not a price.

Example tokens by message role

System, user, and tool text share one window. Sketch. Not a benchmark and not a price.

Facts added by sampling

The bar stays at zero. Temperature, top-p, and top-k do not check facts. Sketch. Not a benchmark and not a price.

What actually checks a claim

Sources, tools, and tests. Asking the model if it is sure does not. Sketch. Not a benchmark and not a price.

Cheaper fixes before a training run

Prompt, schema, retrieval, and tools come first. Train only for a gap those did not close. Sketch. Not a benchmark and not a price.

Verbs that wait for a person

Send, pay, and delete. Read can be allow inside the cap. Sketch. Not a benchmark and not a price.

Product states to design

Empty, slow, wrong, and unsafe start blank until you write them. Sketch. Not a benchmark and not a price.

Capstone gate

Ship and not yet are both finished results. Sketch. Not a benchmark and not a price.

Sketch of latency against a made-up quality axis

Same roles as the latency widget. Up is not a measured score. Sketch. Not a benchmark and not a price.

What a retrieval run must record

Prompt, model id, and index version. A missing pin is not zero. Sketch. Not a benchmark and not a price.

Sampling playground

Fixed logits. Temperature, then top-k, then top-p. They reshape this list. They do not add facts. 0.05 stands in for greedy. Many APIs treat 0 as argmax. Temperature 0 is not bit-identical across machines.

Chunking visualizer

The same short notes as the retrieval widget. This cuts on a character window so you can see a bad split. A real index splits on headings and keeps the heading with the chunk.

Reranker comparison

Hand-set scores. Sort by the first-stage score or the rerank score. The unfetched row stays out. A reranker cannot cite a passage the first stage never returned.

Agent trace replayer

A refund draft. The model may propose send. The policy asks a person. Nothing is sent.

LoRA rank calculator

Trainable count is 2 × rank × (d in + d out) × layers. The defaults are example dimensions, not a model card. The full count is d in × d out × layers.

Quantization memory calculator

Weight gigabytes are billions of parameters times bits/8. A 7B or 8B model at Q4 or Q5 is the course starting point for a 16 GB machine because the runner and KV cache are extra. 8 GB starts smaller. Quantizing weights is not the same thing as training a LoRA adapter.

Schema reject

Required fields are name and query. Missing fields are a reject, not a guess.

Approval payload

Allow read-only inside the cap. Ask before send, pay, or delete. Deny a shell. The person sees the exact arguments.

Idempotency key

The same key and the same arguments replay the stored result. The same key with different arguments is a conflict. A retry must not double-send.

Context fit

Instructions, retrieved text, chat, and the answer share one window. This uses an example window, not a model card.

Hybrid weight

Hand-set keyword score 0.20 and cosine 0.90. The weight is the cosine share.

Retry budget

Each extra try adds a call. This count is not a price. Stop when the budget is spent.

Citation coverage

The required id is notes-01. Check the ids the draft actually cites. A blank list is not a pass.

Step cap

The example cap is 6. At the cap the loop stops, even if the model wants another call.

KV cache sketch

Bytes are 2 × 32 layers × 8 heads × 128 × tokens × 2. A sketch, not a runner report. This is why a 3.5 GB weight file is not the whole memory bill.

Index pin

A retrieval run records the prompt id, the model id, and the index version. Empty is not pinned.

Cite or refuse

Keyword match on the toy notes. If the notes do not contain the question, the answer is a refusal.
